findings.title: Hub rows marked 'verified' whose only source is a non-official site
findings.detail: The brief requires every table row to link an official site and to leave unconfirmed values blank and flagged. The hub's data (data/matches.json) carries verified:true on 34 rows whose sourceUrl is espn.com (8), wikipedia.org (7), bbc.com (5), skysports.com (2), etusuora.com (2), olbg.com (2), olympics.com, basketnews.com, findmygroup.uk, usatoday.com, tempo.co or montpellier.fr. Board D's own board entry states 'every row sourceUrl to governing-body domain', which the data does not support.

findings.rows: NHL01, NHL06, EL02, MLB01, RL01 (and narrative claims in NBA02, EL01, CRK01, CRK04, CRK06, RUG01, RUG02, RUG05, RUG06, BDM02)
findings.title: High-confidence predictions contain form/injury claims contradicted by, or absent from, official sources
findings.detail: NHL01 says the Sharks were 0-4 on their road trip — the NHL preview lists them 4-4-1. NHL06 says Boston were 1-3 on a Texas swing and missing Marchand — the NHL preview lists Boston 7-2-0 and Marchand is not a Bruin. EL02 inverts the EuroLeague records (press lists Efes 2-4, Beşiktaş 3-3), labels 20:30 local as CET, names a venue that disagrees with the broadcaster listing and contains an unedited self-correction ('blowout of Efes? Actually…'). MLB01 cites a 'seven-game ALCS' — it was six games. RL01 describes a 'Pacific Championships Australia v NZ Oct 25 Brisbane' that does not exist in 2026 (RLWC; 25 Oct Brisbane is Australia v Fiji). The remaining rows carry statistics (home records, averages, streaks) that appear on none of the linked sources. Recommend: withdraw or rewrite these predictions from official pages, or move the rows to the hub's Flagged page.

findings.title: Fixture fields that disagree with the governing body
findings.detail: CRK03 labels Pakistan v England as 'Tri-Series Match 1' (PCB: Match 2, 20 Oct, Rawalpindi — Match 1 was Pakistan v Sri Lanka on 18 Oct). CRK05 dates the final 29 Oct (PCB: 31 Oct; 29 Oct is Sri Lanka v England). MLB03 venue reads 'George M. Steinbrenner Field / …' (MLB: Rays host at Tropicana Field). EL02 time '20:30 CET' is 20:30 Istanbul time = 17:30 CET.

findings.title: Hub 'entries' that are not matches
findings.detail: The brief asks for a list of matches. About half of the hub's 66 entries are tournaments, round summaries, completed events used 'for form', off-season notes ('AFL Off-Season — No scheduled matches') or qualification news ('eight clubs confirmed'). Several still carry a pick and confidence (e.g. ATP01 'Medium' with a Kalshi prediction-market percentage; BDM02 'High' outright). These should either be expanded to individual matches with official fixture links or be moved off the match table.

findings.title: Row-level source is OLBG only; confidence derives from tipster consensus
findings.detail: Each Build B row links the OLBG event page as its sole source; only the 9 high-confidence rows add official fact links inside their predictions. The 'own line' is a shrunken transform of the OLBG tip percentage (p = (n·p_c + 1)/(n+2)), so B's probabilities and confidence bands are a function of OLBG tipster votes rather than independently verified form. Build B discloses this in its methodology; it is recorded here because the brief asks for an official link on every row and for lines originated by us.

findings.title: Same fixture, opposite match-winner picks in different builds
findings.detail: 74 fixtures appear in two or more builds; in 6 the builds pick different winners. Most notable: Build C rates Charlotte Hornets a HIGH-confidence pick while Build A picks Brooklyn (low). Because each build uses a different model and a different input snapshot, this is expected, but a reader of the portal sees contradictory picks for the same game with no reconciliation. See the Cross-build page for all 74 overlaps.

findings.title: Timezone labels
findings.detail: Dortmund sessions on 22-24 Oct are CEST (PDC: 1900 CEST); the hub prints CET. EL02 prints Istanbul local time as CET. Not wrong by more than the label, but the brief asks for exactness.

findings.title: What this audit did not do
findings.detail: The sandbox can reach only github/npm/pypi hosts; verification used the agent's web-search/page-fetch tools, and the 18 row checks on the Spot checks page are a sample, not a complete re-verification of all 459 rows. Domain classification is mechanical (list in scripts/session-e1e0c27e/audit.py). Nothing in another board's folder was edited.
